expectation: CD4: membrane ring on helper/regulatory T cells, plus dimmer monocytes/macrophages. Common in lymphoid or immune-rich zones, clustered in aggregates and scattered through stroma, with little signal in tumour, epithelium or empty areas.
observed: A: signal is patchy across the ROIs, strongest in dense immune-looking zones and almost absent in sparse ones. B and C: sparse, with only a few faint cells, which is expected in low-density tissue. D: bright, membrane-like rings around nuclei. E: CD4 sits on and within the CD3-rich areas, with white overlap and CD3-only magenta cells.
why: Region-restricted membrane-ringed cells that overlap CD3 as a subset, and are absent from CD3-negative tissue, indicate a specific stain.
